acceptance.given: The skill authoring standard document is authored for validation.

oracle.expected: The standard explicitly defines its inputs as part of the documented I/O contract.
forbidden: The standard defines I/O without identifying inputs.
oracle.observable: A content assertion evaluated against docs/standards/skill-authoring-standard.md locates an explicit input definition in the standard's I/O section.

acceptance.then: The standard contains an explicit input definition.
acceptance.when: During static artifact validation of the authored standard document.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the planned A01 artifact assertion for the standard and require failure when the input definition is absent or not located in the I/O contract.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or preserve the standard's explicit input definition in its I/O contract.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Documentation-only rollback; no persisted state or schema changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: Standard is being defined -> Inputs are explicitly defined in the standard's I/O contract.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted A01 artifact assertion passes and the standard contains the required input definition.
